label: Candidate operational gaps · team-authored, not expert-validated

gaps.title: Who owns a rehearsal transcript incident?
gaps.operational_gap: A university needs to establish who contains sharing, determines retention and coordinates communication when a practice transcript identifies a learner.

uae_sources.title: UAE Personal Data Protection Law
uae_sources.says: Defines a scoped personal-data framework including processing controls and data-subject rights.
uae_sources.does_not_say: The available indexed provisions and corpus summary do not establish an incident owner or retention schedule for this synthetic case. Full current statutory text and institutional applicability remain unverified.
uae_sources.scope: Federal law; assess actual data, entity, exclusions and jurisdiction.

uae_sources.title: UAE AI Ethics: Principles and Guidelines
uae_sources.locator: Section 1.2, PDF page 4; principles on data and transparency
uae_sources.says: Non-mandatory guidance addresses AI that makes or informs significant or critical decisions.
uae_sources.does_not_say: Does not prescribe a university practice-transcript retention schedule, caption fallback or formative feedback scoring rule.
uae_sources.scope: Non-binding; ordinary rehearsal is a voluntary design reference unless its decision scope applies.

global_examples.title: FERPA
global_examples.addresses: Defines education records, eligible-student rights, consent and exceptions relevant to access and disclosure.
global_examples.scope: US covered educational institutions receiving specified federal funds; not every recording is necessarily an education record.
global_examples.binding_status: Binding US law and regulations for covered institutions; not UAE law.

gaps.verification_status: Candidate operational question; reviewed source provisions do not determine this institution’s process or demonstrate a national legislative gap.
evidence_needed: Applicable institutional incident, access and retention procedures and named owners.
Data classification, actual exposure, provider terms and applicable jurisdiction, including exclusions.

gaps.title: Who agrees and tests a usable caption fallback?
gaps.operational_gap: Teaching, accessibility and privacy owners need a tested way to agree an accessible fallback without unnecessarily identifying a participant or using unchecked audio processing.

uae_sources.title: UAE National Policy for Digital Accessibility
uae_sources.locator: Article 3, PDF page 7; Annex 1 section 1, PDF page 13
uae_sources.says: Identifies covered entities and services and references WCAG 2.1 AA for public-service sites in the policy context.
uae_sources.does_not_say: Does not establish a specific university workshop caption fallback or blanket coverage of every private university.
uae_sources.scope: Federal/connected entities under Article 3; others are asked to consider best efforts.

uae_sources.title: UAEU Students of Determination Services
uae_sources.locator: Services: accommodation plans, faculty coordination and alternative formats
uae_sources.says: Describes individual accommodation plans and faculty coordination.
uae_sources.does_not_say: Does not establish another university’s caption contingency or that a particular substitute is usable.
uae_sources.scope: Institutional service example at UAEU, not a nationwide rule.

global_examples.title: WCAG 2.2
global_examples.addresses: Specifies captions for prerecorded and live synchronized media, with criteria-specific exceptions.
global_examples.scope: Technical accessibility standard; distinguishes prerecorded level A and live level AA.
global_examples.binding_status: Voluntary standard unless incorporated by an applicable legal or contractual instrument; no automatic UAE applicability.

global_examples.title: ADA Title II web accessibility rule
global_examples.addresses: Sets web and mobile accessibility requirements with a WCAG 2.1 AA technical standard and exceptions.
global_examples.scope: US public entities, including public universities; scope, exceptions and implementation deadlines matter.
global_examples.binding_status: Binding US rule for covered public entities; not UAE law.

gaps.verification_status: Candidate operational question; scope and implementation at the specific institution remain unverified.
evidence_needed: Institutional accommodations and continuity procedures, responsible owners and attendee preferences.
Vendor processing terms, approval route and practical testing of alternatives.

gaps.title: How is formative feedback distinguished and challenged?
gaps.operational_gap: A university needs a clear, accessible explanation and human-owned correction or challenge route when AI practice feedback resembles an official grade.

uae_sources.title: UAE AI Ethics: Principles and Guidelines
uae_sources.locator: Section 1.2, PDF page 4; principles on data and transparency
uae_sources.says: Non-mandatory guidance addresses AI that makes or informs significant or critical decisions.
uae_sources.does_not_say: Does not prescribe a university practice-transcript retention schedule, caption fallback or formative feedback scoring rule.
uae_sources.scope: Non-binding; ordinary rehearsal is a voluntary design reference unless its decision scope applies.

uae_sources.title: UAEU Generative AI Usage by the Students Policy
uae_sources.says: Addresses student GenAI use, permissions and academic work.
uae_sources.does_not_say: Does not set a general university staff-rehearsal feedback or challenge procedure.
uae_sources.scope: UAEU students and covered work for academic credit; not all UAE universities or staff rehearsal.

uae_sources.title: CAA Outcomes-Based Evaluation Framework University Guide
uae_sources.locator: University Guide overview and Data Submission Guidelines
uae_sources.says: The reviewed public overview describes higher-education quality assurance and learning-outcome evaluation.
uae_sources.does_not_say: This overview does not establish how a rehearsal tool must distinguish formative AI feedback from official assessment. Detailed former 2019 standard provisions were inaccessible.
uae_sources.scope: UAE higher-education evaluation guidance; actual institutional coverage and detailed assessment/record/support provisions remain unverified.

global_examples.title: EU AI Act
global_examples.addresses: Identifies some education systems intended to evaluate learning outcomes as high-risk and addresses AI literacy.
global_examples.scope: EU risk classification depends on intended use and statutory conditions; not every formative feedback tool is high-risk.
global_examples.binding_status: Binding EU regulation; phased application and exceptions apply, not UAE law.

global_examples.title: TEQSA Assessment Reform for the Age of Artificial Intelligence
global_examples.addresses: Discusses redesigning assessment and maintaining credible human assessment in the presence of AI.
global_examples.scope: Australian higher-education assessment context, not this UAE rehearsal deployment.
global_examples.binding_status: Non-prescriptive guidance/discussion paper, not a UAE requirement.

gaps.verification_status: Candidate deployment-level standards question; reviewed material does not establish a deficiency in national law or any specific university policy.
evidence_needed: Applicable institutional assessment and feedback policies, ownership and challenge process.
Accessibility and usability tests with affected students, evidence of score use, and vendor correction and retention terms.
